claims.claim: exp-003 generated real calibration and evaluation JSONL files for general_chat, code, and math_reasoning.
claims.notes: Manifest status is completed and records 64 calibration plus 12 evaluation samples per domain.

claims.claim: exp-003 produced three real-calibrated NVFP4 W4A4 Qwen3-4B variants.
claims.notes: Each quantize log has status=completed and scores.json records 3/3 completed variants.

claims.claim: All real-calibrated NVFP4 variants had higher NLL than the base model on all three evaluated domains.
claims.notes: Every non-base row has positive delta_nll_vs_base.

claims.claim: Matched-domain calibration did not produce the best quantized NLL in any evaluated domain.
claims.notes: Best quantized variants are math_reasoning for general_chat, general_chat for code, and code for math_reasoning.

claims.claim: exp-003 ran a 4-sample-per-task GSM8K/MBPP task smoke pilot for base and all three NVFP4 variants.
claims.notes: eval_tasks.json status is completed and records 4 GSM8K plus 4 MBPP samples per model.

claims.claim: The small task pilot did not show a matched-domain advantage.
claims.notes: code calibration scored 3/4 on MBPP versus base and general_chat calibration at 4/4; math_reasoning calibration scored 1/4 on GSM8K, tied with base and general_chat, while code calibration scored 0/4.
